page: Amazon Web Services c8id.24xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 6975P-C processor with 96 vCPUs and 48 physical cores operating at 3.9 GHz. The system includes 192.0 GB of DDR5 memory running at 7 GHz, providing 2.0 GB of RAM per core. For local storage, the instance is equipped with 5700 GB of NVMe SSD instance store volumes. Network connectivity is supported by a 40 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core capabilities, with top-tier performance in Geekbench multi-core, software compilation, and ray tracing. The processor's advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512 and Intel AMX (Advanced Matrix Extensions), contribute to top-tier results in Passmark extended instructions and encryption tests. Memory performance is notable, with small-block read-only bandwidth reaching the top 10% of tested systems. The instance also demonstrates top-tier throughput in static web serving, Redis SET operations, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression.

This instance delivers high resource density for compute-intensive and storage-heavy workloads without the overhead of external network storage. The combination of dedicated Intel Xeon cores, high-speed DDR5 memory, and a large local NVMe SSD makes it highly cost-efficient for database operations, large-scale software compilation, and medium-to-large LLM prompt processing. The absence of a dedicated GPU limits its utility for heavy graphics rendering, but its CPU-based matrix acceleration handles inference tasks efficiently.
